name: Standard OD
source: NAS1149 "WASHER, FLAT", Table I, Rev 4 (2008-02), size-and-thickness code 0463. innerDiameter = dia A (+/-.010), outerDiameter = dia D (+.020/-.005), thickness = T. Table I is a matrix (each thread size offers only certain thicknesses; cells not listed are explicitly prohibited -- 'overcoding of part numbers to specify washer sizes not listed in this standard is prohibited'). Part number assembles as NAS1149<material code><size-and-thickness code><finish code> with NO separators or hyphens (confirmed against sheet 3's 'EXAMPLE OF PART NUMBER' block, e.g. NAS1149D0432K = aluminum, anodized, .250 nominal dia, .032 thick); the key here uses the bare NAS11490463 form (document number + size-and-thickness code, no material/finish letters, no hyphen -- consistent with the standard's own no-separator assembly), material chosen separately in the GUI's washer-material dropdown. DELIBERATE OMISSION: Table I also lists NO.9, NO.11 and NO.12 rows, and sizes from .875 up to 2.500 -- none are seeded because the bolt catalog stops at 3/4 and has no #9/#11/#12, so they could never be resolved by washersFor().
